name: Parcel Therapist
pitch: A single-screen postal chatbot where a no-nonsense mail carrier reframes the user's problem as a package issue and offers cheesy but caring postal advice. It feels wholesome and surprising because ordinary stress becomes a fragile label, a lost stamp, or a parcel needing a softer cushion.
form: rule-based chat character (no AI) with a strong personality
twist: it must fit on a single screen
